description.en: Offline search in images, scanned and mixed PDFs, and images embedded in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Incremental indexing with highlighted previews. Once indexed, type the picture's words straight into the search box.
description.zh: 离线搜索图片、扫描与混排 PDF、Word / PPT / Excel 内嵌图片中的文字。选择目录，后台增量识别，预览高亮命中位置。建好索引后直接在搜索框输入图片里的文字即可搜到。

notes.zh: 窗口用上了 Win顺 0.52.0 更省内存的界面零件：一个图标从五个对象变成一个，焦点框、开关的光晕、按钮尾巴上的图标这些平时看不到的部分第一次要用时才做出来；输入框的光标对齐到整像素，125% 缩放下不再看不见（#501）。Windows 内存用到 70% 以上时，闲着时照样把内存让出来；以前到 80% 就一点都不还（#500）。权限不变。
notes.en: Its windows use the lighter controls of WinShun 0.52.0: an icon is one object instead of five, and parts hardly ever shown (focus rings, a switch's glow, a button's trailing icon) are made the first time they are wanted; the caret of its text fields sits on a whole pixel, so it shows at 125 % (#501). With 70 % or more of the memory in use it gives its memory back while idle all the same; from 80 % it used to give nothing back (#500). Permissions unchanged.
